title: fix(console): a refused organization delete lists what remains by object label, in the user's language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQvXLoyHKgDngdbpecXci6e)_

Fixes #32648

Clause-②: yes (widening: organization.settings.deleteRestricted, organization.settings.deleteRestrictedOther)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除组织被服务端拒绝（组织里还有记录）时，确认对话框不再弹出英文报错和 `sys_*` 内部表名，而是用当前界面语言列出还剩哪些记录（对象名称加数量）；危险区和确认框的文案改为如实说明删除规则。
- 为什么改：页面原来承诺“永久删除该组织及其全部数据”，但服务端在组织仍有记录时会拒绝删除；拒绝后用户看到一整段英文和内部表名，像系统崩溃，也不知道下一步该做什么。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端展示、文案和客户端错误对象，服务端 409 拒绝契约不变；有问题直接 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`SettingsPage.tsx`（确认按钮的 `preventDefault` 与拒绝分支）、`orgErrorMessage.ts`（`readOrgDeleteRefusal` / `orgDeleteRefusalRows`）、`createAuthClient.ts`（`toAuthError` 带上 `dependents`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/org-i18n-holdouts-4474.test.tsx -t 32648`，预期 6 个用例全部通过，其中中文用例的对话框列出“环境 2、域名 2、其他记录 4”。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位（domain:ui#6）对照 diff 复核：拒绝只按 `DELETE_RESTRICTED` 码识别，服务端英文与 `sys_*` 表名都不再显示；其余失败照旧弹提示并关框；新增两个文案键，属于语言包公开面的扩大，已按默认档复核通过。CI 全绿，按队列落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/auth`**: `toAuthError` now carries the error body's `dependents` (`[{ object, count }]`; an entry without a non-empty `object` is dropped, a `count` that is not a non-negative integer is left out) and a producer-marked `userMessage`, beside `code` and `message`. Every `organization.*` method already throws through it, so `deleteOrganization` keeps plugin-auth's 409 list.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`** (`console/organizations`, existing files only): `readOrgDeleteRefusal` reads a `DELETE_RESTRICTED` rejection by code alone, and `orgDeleteRefusalRows` lists each dependent under its object label, with every dependent no label resolves for counted on one localized "Other records" line. `SettingsPage` keeps the confirm dialog open on that refusal (the action's `preventDefault`, the pattern `PackagesPage` already uses) and shows the console's own frame sentence plus that list in place of the slug field, with the confirm disabled. The server's English `message` is never read, translated or shown, and no API name is shown in a label's place. Any other failure still toasts and closes the dialog, as before.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**, all eleven shipped packs: `organization.settings.deleteDescription` and `organization.settings.deleteConfirmDescription` now state the real contract (the organization is deleted with its members and invitations; while it still holds records the delete is refused and nothing is removed). Two keys are added: `organization.settings.deleteRestricted` (the frame sentence) and `organization.settings.deleteRestrictedOther` (the "Other records" line). That is the Clause-② widening the claim declares: the entry exports `en` and `TranslationKeys = typeof en`.
- Changeset: `.changeset/32648-org-delete-refusal.md`, patch for the three packages.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/org-error-code-4474.test.ts`, new top-level describe: the real better-auth client through a mocked fetch, a 409 body with `dependents` → the thrown error carries them, the message is unchanged, malformed entries are dropped, a body without a usable list carries no `dependents` key, and `userMessage` is carried only when non-blank.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/orgErrorMessage-4474.test.ts`, new top-level describe: the reader keys on the code and never the text; the rows put labels first and gather unlabelled objects on one line, whose count is withheld when a member's is.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/org-i18n-holdouts-4474.test.tsx`, new top-level describe, under the REAL `I18nProvider` with a server bundle loaded through the same `loadLanguage` + `transformSpecTranslations` path the console uses: zh and en renders of the refused delete (frame sentence in the session language, labels with counts, no `sys_` substring anywhere on the page, no server sentence, no toast, confirm disabled), the danger-zone and confirm copy, the all-unlabelled case, the `userMessage` frame, and the unchanged toast-and-close path for any other failure.

## Acceptance notes

- **Where object labels come from.** From the server translation bundle the console already loads at sign-in (`/api/v1/i18n/translations/:locale`, through `loadLanguage`), resolved by `useObjectLabel().objectLabel` as `app.objects.NAME.label`. No new request and no metadata read: the organization pages render outside every `MetadataProvider`, so `/meta` labels are not in reach there. The bundle is served to any signed-in caller (ADR-0056 D2 floor) and is not filtered per object, so an organization owner without metadata read access to a `sys_*` object still gets every label the bundle carries. Reading at `a8c761fbe` (objectstack): 84 of the 104 in-repo platform objects (`PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE`) carry an `en` bundle entry. The cloud-provided objects on the card (`sys_environment`, `sys_billing_*`, `sys_domain`, …) are defined in cloud, so whether their labels resolve depends on cloud shipping bundle entries for them: NOT MEASURED here. **Choice for an unresolved label:** it is counted on one localized "Other records" line with the summed count (the count is left out if any member's was withheld), never shown as the API name or a humanised API name.
- **Pre-check skipped.** No existing read gives the counts: plugin-auth computes them only inside the `/organization/delete` admission (`organizationOwnedRowCounts`), and no read door exposes them. Counting from the client would need a read per tenant table the console cannot enumerate, so it would be a new server door.
- **Frame sentence and #32654.** The frame is console copy, not translated server prose. When the error carries a producer-marked `userMessage` (the carrier ruled C on #32440 and #32043, tracked on #32654, not built yet), it is used as the frame instead; a one-line code comment points there. `toAuthError` carries `userMessage` so that this path can work once the server sends it.
- **ADR-0060 (frozen `console/organizations/`).** No file is added, moved or renamed under the frozen directory; the three test pins are new top-level describes in existing harness files, and the new keys sit under `organization.settings` (the singular `organization` namespace, which the ADR's baseline does not freeze). `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts` passed in the targeted run below. The ratchet counts files, not lines, so `SettingsPage.tsx` and `orgErrorMessage.ts` grew without moving it.
- **Why the render pins are not in SettingsPage's slug harness.** `settings-slug-environments-11720.test.tsx` mocks `useObjectTranslation` as an en oracle, which cannot tell localized output from a fallback; `org-i18n-holdouts-4474.test.tsx` is the organization console's real-provider harness, so the pins went there as a top-level describe (no new file).
- **Observed side effect.** Radix's `AlertDialogAction` closes the dialog on click, so the confirm button's existing spinner was never visible; with `preventDefault` the dialog now stays open while the delete runs and the spinner shows.
- **Copy scope.** The danger-zone copy says the delete removes "members and invitations". For a non-default organization plugin-auth also removes its teams and its organization-admin grants; the copy names only what every organization's delete removes.

- At `498f3fa25`: the re-run had reached 15 of 37 when this PR was opened, all exit 0; the rest are **NOT MEASURED** at this head (reason: the PR was opened on the maintainer's request before that run finished). After the changeset edit, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` and `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` were re-run and exit 0.
- Also run: `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0; `node ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` exit 0 (`4684/4684 literal keys resolve`, every inline default matches its `en` value); `node ui/scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` exit 0 (`0 new citation(s)`).
- **NOT MEASURED locally**: `ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` (its first run, before the deps build, exited with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for `@objectstack/spec/dist`, so it never reached its own verdict); the CI type-check lanes; full dogfood (not owed: no `!` and no `(narrowing)` arm). All of them run in CI on this PR.
